note: Stable site-plan element identifiers. Selectors point at existing generated SVG layers; no coordinates are duplicated. 'Text only' elements are not legible at site-plan scale and are linked to the relevant building drawings.

elements.label: Whole site
elements.description: The complete fictional parcel: terrain, water, wetland, woodland, rocks, paths, buildings and buffers.
elements.note: Fictional site; not a survey or legal plan.

elements.label: Landscape
elements.description: Terrain, contours, woodland, individual tree symbols, rock, wetland and the illustrative buffers.
elements.note: No tree survey, habitat assessment, hydrology model or legal setback confirmation.

elements.label: Common land / gathering places
elements.description: Cleared and gathering areas shown on the site plan. The plan does not prove ownership, tenure or public access.
elements.note: Common ownership, stewardship and legal access are not mapped.

elements.label: Paths, lanes and access
elements.description: Vehicle lane, parking, accessible arrival, pedestrian paths, trails and emergency/maintenance access.
elements.note: Widths, grades, surfacing, winter maintenance and accessibility are placeholders.

elements.label: Common lodge
elements.description: The common lodge footprint in the site plan.
elements.note: The lodge is a concept; assembly occupancy, egress and fire separation are not assessed.

elements.label: Individual homes
elements.description: The six selected-home assignment footprints in the illustrative site plan.
elements.note: Footprints are illustrative and may conflict with older site-model geometry; see the reconciliation table.

elements.label: Porches and outdoor rooms
elements.description: Porch and outdoor-room geometry is shown on building plans, not legibly at site-plan scale.
elements.note: Not highlighted on the site plan; use the building elevation and plans.

elements.label: Interiors
elements.description: Rooms, partitions, fixtures and clearances are building-drawing data, not site-plan layers.
elements.note: Not highlighted on the site plan; use the interior plans.

elements.label: Shared workshop
elements.description: The workshop is an activity inside the common lodge; it has no separate site-plan footprint.
elements.note: The lodge footprint is highlighted, not a separate workshop building.

elements.label: Visitor arrival
elements.description: The entrance lane, parking/drop-off and lodge arrival area shown on the site plan.
elements.note: Wayfinding, lighting, winter clearing and accessible arrival are not verified.
